verdict.rationale: Graphite ships its own AI reviewer that analyzes every PR to identify potential issues, catch bugs, and suggest fixes, and custom rules let teams give it explicit review guidelines. Security findings are never specifically documented, so whether it catches security issues alongside functional bugs is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of security-issue detection (injection risks, leaked secrets, insecure patterns), examples of security findings in reviews, and independent or hands-on corroboration of security review accuracy.
